desc: Read input and compute prefix distinct array `f[i]` and suffix distinct array `g[j]`.
Precompute `next[i]` (next occurrence index of `A[i]`, or `N+1` if none).
Build a segment tree supporting range add, range max, and point set over indices `1..N-1`.
Initialize the tree for `j = N-1` with value `1 + g[N-1]`.
Iterate `i` from `N-2` down to `1`: query max over `[i+1, N-1]`, add `f[i]` to get a candidate answer, then range-add `1` on `[i+1, min(next[i]-1, N-1)]` and point-set index `i` to `1 + g[i]`.
Test the solution on the provided sample inputs.
